plan.notes: Transcribed from the official SCC 'Library and Information Technology Certificate' program map, Catalog 2025-26, published October 08, 2025 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/6883/PublishedPdf). Official Total Units: 24 = 10+14, verified against the map's 10 / 14 headers. This is a Certificate of Achievement (no GE pattern; all courses are major/major-elective). Choice slots: (1) LIBT 325 / LIBR 325 (Internet Research Skills); (2) LIBT 340 / LIBT 341 / LIBT 342 (Running a School Library Media Center). In-plan prereqs sequenced: LIBT 300 requires LIBT 100 (C or better; the two may be taken concurrently); LIBT 330, 333, 343, 345 each require LIBT 100 & LIBT 300 (C or better) or current enrollment in both; LIBT 331 requires LIBT 100, 300, and 330 (C or better); LIBT 348 requires LIBT 100, 300, 330, 331, and 343 (C or better). Certificates of Achievement require a grade of C or better in each major course (map note). tccns mirrors SCC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS).
